title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Mark 14: the anointing at Bethany, the Passover meal, Gethsemane, the trial before the high priest and Peter's denial.

questions.text: Where was Jesus when a woman poured ointment of pure nard over his head?
questions.explanation: He was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, sitting at the table, when the woman broke the alabaster jar and poured it over his head.

answers.text: In the temple at Jerusalem, during the feast
On the Mount of Olives, after the supper
At Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper
In a boat on the lake with his disciples

questions.text: For how much did the indignant onlookers say the ointment might have been sold?
questions.explanation: They said it might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.

answers.text: More than three hundred denarii
Thirty pieces of silver
Two hundred denarii
A hundred pieces of gold

questions.text: What did Jesus say the woman had done for him?
questions.explanation: He said she had done what she could, and had anointed his body beforehand for the burying.

answers.text: Paid a debt he owed
Kept the ointment for the poor
Shown the disciples her wealth
Anointed his body beforehand for the burying

questions.text: Who went away to the chief priests in order to deliver Jesus to them?
questions.explanation: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests so that he might deliver him to them.

answers.text: Simon the leper of Bethany
Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve
One of the scribes of the city
A servant of the high priest

questions.text: What did Jesus say to the disciples as he gave them the cup?
questions.explanation: He said that this is his blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

answers.text: "This is my blood of the new covenant"
"Drink it in remembrance of Moses"
"This cup is the Passover of the Lord"
"Keep this cup until I return"

questions.text: What did Jesus tell Peter would happen before the rooster crowed twice?
questions.explanation: He told Peter that that very night, before the rooster crowed twice, Peter would deny him three times.

answers.text: Peter would run away to Galilee
Peter would be arrested with him
Peter would deny him three times
Peter would fall asleep three times

questions.text: Whom did Jesus take with him when he began to be greatly troubled?
questions.explanation: He took with him Peter, James and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

answers.text: Peter, Andrew and John
Peter, James and Andrew
James, John and Judas
Peter, James and John

questions.text: What did Jesus ask of the Father when he prayed at Gethsemane?
questions.explanation: He said, "Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire."

answers.text: That his disciples would be kept awake with him
That the cup be removed from him, yet the Father's will be done
That the hour of his betrayal would come quickly
That the one who betrayed him would be stopped

questions.text: What did Jesus answer when the high priest asked him whether he was the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
questions.explanation: He said, "I am," and added that they would see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of the sky.

answers.text: He said, "Ask those who heard me"
He said, "So you say"
He said, "I am"
He asked the high priest a question in return

questions.text: What did Peter say when a maid of the high priest said he had been with Jesus the Nazarene?
questions.explanation: He denied it, saying that he neither knew nor understood what she was saying, and he went out on the porch.

answers.text: He admitted that he was one of the disciples
He denied it and said he did not understand her
He told her to be silent and went away
He said he was only there to warm himself
